title: High performance self-assembled pyrene-based emitter with narrowband emission and excellent luminescence efficiency
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25771-25775
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03596A, Paper

Zhongxing Geng, Zhentan Wang, Hailong Liu, Xiangyi Su, Liangyu Hu, Fengyan Song, Kun Yao
Herein, the obtained novel compound DtBuCzB-Py not only exhibited narrowband emission (FWHM = 25 nm in toluene solution) and high fluorescence quantum yield (ΦF = 77.2% in toluene solution), but also strong self-assembly ability.
